terms.gloss: allot, assign, bestow; grant, pay (thanks, honour)
terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation; the thing in the accusative, the person in the dative
evidence: Cic. Off. 1.14: in tribuendō suum cuique (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Imp. Pomp. 52: sī ūnī omnia tribuenda sint (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From tribus, properly to deal out by tribes (Lewis & Short). Of rewards and gifts, and of thanks, pardon, honour and credit.
